dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: I'm talking about a commission that I took on a while back.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: I thought at the time that it was a low-ranking commission, and what was more, the commissioner was Su— Ahem, I mean, a lady alchemist whose work I've admired for a time now.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: ...At the time, I thought that we might be able to strike up some sort of long-term cooperative relationship should I complete the commission...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: But when I regained my senses, I realized that I'd bitten off more than I could chew...
